about: Cowmire Creek-Missouri River drains about 36 square miles, 26% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 630 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 400 feet at its lowest. Its main stream is Cowmire Creek. It includes part of St. Charles. Downstream, its water passes through the Outlet Missouri River watershed on its way down the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
